sentences.en: If you would like to write us or record a voice note, please go to howwemadeyourmother.com, H-W-M-Y-M.

sentences.en: I just came across your podcast the last couple of weeks and have already finished the first season.
sentences.zh: 我在过去几周里偶然发现了你们的播客，并且已经听完了第一季。

sentences.en: It's making me feel very nostalgic.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到非常怀旧。

sentences.en: Although I must have watched your show when it first came out, my fond memories are of watching it a few years later with my two young sons,
sentences.zh: 虽然我肯定在你们的节目刚开播时就看过，但我美好的回忆是在几年后和我的两个年幼的儿子一起观看，

sentences.en: starting when they were probably four and six years old.
sentences.zh: 从他们大概四岁和六岁的时候开始。

sentences.en: As a full-time working mom with a 40 to 60-minute commute to the kids' school and my office, the end of the day was exhausting.
sentences.zh: 作为一名全职工作的妈妈，每天往返于孩子学校和我的办公室需要40到60分钟的车程，一天的结束总是精疲力竭。

sentences.en: After some time, an hour in traffic, it was shuffling kids and all their things into the house, making dinner while helping with homework, washing dishes, and cleaning up.
sentences.zh: 在堵车一小时后，还得把孩子们和他们所有的东西弄进屋里，一边做饭一边辅导作业，洗碗盘，然后打扫卫生。

sentences.en: Then the three of us would plop down on the couch and watch How I Met Your Mother.
sentences.zh: 然后我们三个就会一屁股坐在沙发上，观看《老爸老妈的浪漫史》。

sentences.en: They were too young to understand all the jokes.
sentences.zh: 他们太小了，还不能理解所有的笑话。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But they loved the show anyway.
sentences.zh: 但他们无论如何都很喜欢这个节目。

sentences.en: And I love how time slowed down while we watched.
sentences.zh: 我也很喜欢我们一起看电视时那种慢下来的时光。

sentences.en: With my youngest sitting snugly in my lap and my oldest cuddled up next to me, it was my half hour of adult time that the kids took part in.
sentences.zh: 小儿子舒服地坐在我怀里，大儿子紧挨着我挤在我身旁，这是属于我的半小时成人时间，孩子们也参与其中。

sentences.en: After the show was over, the TV would go off and it was back to racing around for bath time, teeth brushing, books before bed, and settling down.
sentences.zh: 节目结束后，电视就会关掉，接着又是忙乱的洗澡时间、刷牙、睡前故事，然后准备入睡。

sentences.en: Watching the show, there were probably a few times where I had to cover their eyes, but for the most part, it gave me the chance to explain things like,
sentences.zh: 看节目的时候，大概有几次我不得不捂住他们的眼睛，但大部分时间，它让我有机会解释一些事情，比如，

sentences.en: Barney is showing how not to be.
sentences.zh: 巴尼正在示范如何不要成为那样的人。

sentences.en: I was pleased when my friend said he wanted to be just like Marshall and Lily when he grew up.
sentences.zh: 当我的朋友说他长大后想成为像马歇尔和莉莉那样的人时，我很高兴。

sentences.en: As they got older, we continued to watch on the couch, sometimes binge-watching during a rainstorm or a sick day.
sentences.zh: 随着他们长大，我们继续在沙发上观看，有时在暴风雨天或生病请假在家时会疯狂刷剧。

sentences.en: Soon, they were teenagers who came and went, so I would sit on the couch and watch an episode or two by myself.
sentences.zh: 很快，他们成了来去匆匆的青少年，于是我会自己坐在沙发上看上一两集。

sentences.en: In passing, they'd often ask which one I was watching, and all I'd have to say was a word or phrase like snowstorm or boats, boats, boats, and they'd know immediately.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，他们经常会问我在看哪一集，而我只需要说出一个词或短语，比如暴风雨或船、船、船，他们立刻就能心领神会。

sentences.en: Sometimes if we were bored, I'd say, give me two numbers, and they'd randomly pick two numbers.
sentences.zh: 有时如果我们觉得无聊，我会说，给我两个数字，然后他们会随机挑选两个数字。

sentences.en: First one for season, the second one for episode, and we'd watch that episode together and know we would be a good one.
sentences.zh: 第一个代表季数，第二个代表集数，然后我们会一起看那一集，并且知道这会是很棒的一集。

sentences.en: Now my oldest is away on the mainland at college, and I'm starting to feel the dread of an empty neSt.
sentences.zh: 现在我的大儿子在大陆上大学，我开始体会到空巢期的焦虑。

sentences.en: My youngest is not so young anymore, but will sit and watch with me as a happy palate cleanser after watching something scary or dark before bed.
sentences.zh: 我的小儿子已经不再那么小了，但在睡前看了恐怖或黑暗的内容后，他会坐在我身边和我一起看，作为一个快乐的心灵清道夫。

sentences.en: My oldest recently texted me a photo of himself in a suit.
sentences.zh: 我的大儿子最近给我发了一张他穿着西装的照片。

sentences.en: For a kid who grew up in Hawaii, it's not something you see.
sentences.zh: 对于一个在夏威夷长大的孩子来说，这可不常见。

sentences.en: Before making a presentation, and I had the sincerest pleasure of texting back, you suited up.
sentences.zh: 在进行演示之前，我有幸由衷地回复了一条短信：你穿上西装了。

sentences.en: I will forever equate how I met your mother with the feeling of sitting with my boys, laughing together, sometimes crying together,
sentences.zh: 我永远会将《老爸老妈的浪漫史》与和我家男孩们坐在一起、一起欢笑、有时一起哭泣的感觉画上等号，

sentences.en: and being present with each other to enjoy 20 minutes of stillness.
sentences.zh: 并且彼此陪伴，享受20分钟的宁静。

sentences.en: I was lucky to have many of these moments throughout their childhood where I could marvel at the observations of a five-year-old and then nine-year-old,
sentences.zh: 我很幸运在他们的童年时期有过许多这样的时刻，我可以惊叹于一个五岁和一个九岁孩子的观察力，

sentences.en: then a teenager with some show sparking conversation and some inspiring contemplation.
sentences.zh: 然后是一个青少年，某些剧集引发了对话，某些激发了沉思。

sentences.en: I'm hopeful that when both my kids are fully grown adults and I'm a wrinkly old woman, I'll be able to call or text them wherever they are and say,
sentences.zh: 我希望当我的两个孩子都完全长大成人，而我成了一个满脸皱纹的老太太时，无论他们在哪里，我都能够打电话或发短信给他们说，

sentences.en: a zitch dog, or thank you, Linus, or suit up, and they'll know exactly what I mean.
sentences.zh: 一只蠢狗，或者谢谢你，里纳斯，或者穿上西装，而他们会完全明白我的意思。

sentences.en: And as an access point to bond with your kids, my son watches the show with us occasionally.
sentences.zh: 作为与孩子们建立亲密关系的切入点，我儿子偶尔会和我们一起看这个节目。
